title: A Veil for the Choir
author: Astrid Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Reyes, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
